subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine capabilities, status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway/plugin control API after the session-targeting blocker is fixed?
rationale: The session-key bug is mechanical, but the PR establishes a new public Gateway route and optional context-engine plugin contract with read/admin operator semantics that automation cannot choose as product direction.

options.title: Approve after targeting fix
options.body: Keep the proposed core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, documentation, and maintainer-reviewed scope semantics before merge.

options.title: Narrow the API first
options.body: Land only read-scoped capabilities/status/doctor and defer admin rotate until maintainers are ready to own that operator action.

options.title: Defer to plugin/private surfaces
options.body: Pause or close the core PR and keep context-engine maintenance control plugin-owned until a broader Gateway control contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve after targeting fix
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, documentation, and maintainer-reviewed scope semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman introduced and evolved the context-engine plugin contract that this PR would extend with control hooks.
